text: ITR-5 is applicable to firms, LLPs, AOPs, BOIs, cooperative societies, and local authorities that are not required to file ITR-7.
Entities such as partnership firms and LLPs with income from business or profession must file ITR-5.
Provide entity details such as PAN, name, address, nature of business, and filing status accurately.
Report income and expenses as per books of accounts, including gross receipts, expenses, and net profit.
Provide details of assets, liabilities, capital accounts, loans, and reserves as at the end of the year.
Compute business income after considering admissible expenses, depreciation, and disallowances.
Firms must provide details of partners, their profit-sharing ratio, remuneration, and interest paid.
Report short-term and long-term capital gains arising from transfer of capital assets.
Include income such as interest, dividends, and other taxable receipts not covered elsewhere.
Claim deductions under Chapter VI-A such as 80G, 80IA, and other applicable provisions.
Compute tax liability based on total income, applicable rates, surcharge, and cess.
Report tax deducted or collected at source as per certificates and Form 26AS.
Provide details of advance tax and self-assessment tax payments with challan information.
Provide details of all bank accounts held and select one account for receiving refund, if any.
Enter audit report details if the entity is liable to tax audit under applicable laws.
If turnover exceeds prescribed limits, audit details must be furnished to avoid filing errors.
Verify the return through digital signature or other permitted modes to complete filing.
Return filing is incomplete unless verification is successfully completed within the allowed time.
